message: You know, there’s nothing quite like a storm to remind you of the comedy of not being ready. I once found myself in a downpour with only a flimsy umbrella that flipped inside out—talk about a fashion statement! 🌧️ If you’re looking to avoid my luck, it might be worth checking out some tips on staying cool and calm during extreme weather. What’s your favorite ‘oops’ moment when preparing for a storm?
